title: Voltage warning and standby
body_md: If the supply voltage falls permanently below 11.2 V, Pro-finder switches to standby mode to save the battery and sends a message about it. It returns to normal operation only when the voltage rises above 12.5 V again. In one operating mode this warning does not apply.
source_region: Chapter 4, explanation of the message type “Voltage warning”
prev_context: Before this stands the theft report.
next_context: Further message types follow on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 19: equivalent in substance, including both thresholds and the excluded operating mode. The English source sets the values without a space (DSC-019); the numbers are the same. Neither version says what standby mode means for the tracking function.
